SharedBouquet.title: SharedBouquet
SharedBouquet.description: A shared bouquet short-link record storing the compressed bouquet payload, optional voice recording, retention policy, and recipient engagement metrics.

code.description: Short alphanumeric code used in the URL path (/<code>)

payload.description: Compact hash payload (#g=... or #b=...) encoding the bouquet arrangement and card

voiceAudioDataUrl.description: Optional base64 audio data URL for the voice keepsake recording

voiceStyle.description: Selected voice keepsake style (mixtape, vinyl, plushie, musicbox, locket)

voiceTitle.description: Display label on the voice keepsake

voiceDurationSec.description: Duration of the voice recording in seconds

openCount.description: Number of times the recipient opened and unwrapped the bouquet

voicePlayCount.description: Number of times the voice keepsake was played

reaction.description: Optional heartfelt reaction symbol/type left by the recipient

recipientReply.description: Optional short thank-you note written by the recipient back to the sender

repliedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the recipient sent a reaction or reply

isPremium.description: Whether the bouquet is an Eternal Keepsake (never expires on the Lace Garland)

retentionDays.description: Number of days the bouquet stays active on the Lace Garland (30 for free, 90 for paid extended, 36500 for eternal)

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the bouquet link was created

StudioGlobalStats.title: StudioGlobalStats
StudioGlobalStats.description: Public aggregate counters for the landing page live impact showcase.

bouquetsOpened.description: Total gift bouquets unwrapped by recipients

reactionsSent.description: Total heartfelt reactions and thank-you notes sent

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last stat update

StudioPass.title: StudioPass
StudioPass.description: Zero-login Couture Studio Pass record bound to the owner's device hash and session nonce.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the pass was issued

expiresAt.description: ISO timestamp when the pass expires

retentionDays.description: Bouquet retention lifespan in days (90 for single/7d, 36500 for 30d)

isEternalKeepsake.description: Whether bouquets created with this pass are Eternal Keepsakes

primaryDeviceHash.description: SHA/FNV hash of the primary device that unlocked the pass

secondaryDeviceHash.description: Optional hash of at most 1 transferred device (empty string if unused)

activeSessionNonce.description: Current single-active-session nonce preventing concurrent pass sharing

boundBouquetCode.description: For 'single' tier, the bouquet code locked to this single unlock

dailyUsageDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD date for fair-use velocity tracking

signature.description: Server cryptographic signature preventing client tampering

/shared_bouquets/{code}.description: Publicly readable and creatable shared bouquet short links so recipients can open their gift on any device without signing in.

/studio_stats/{statId}.description: Global studio counters for bouquets created, voice notes recorded, bouquets opened, and reactions sent.

/studio_passes/{passKey}.description: Zero-login Studio Pass records lookup by exact BLOOM-XXXX-XXXX Pass Key with anti-sharing device binding and immutable tier/expiry.
